new_hypothesis.name: creator_wallet_velocity_rug_guard
new_hypothesis.mechanism: The bot's existing top-5 concentration gate (LP-aware version shipped run-256) treats top-1 holder as a single number and excludes only LP_OWNER_PROGRAMS. But every pump.fun graduate carries a structural 20.69% holder that is the LP-locked share (206.9M of 1B supply deposited at graduation) — the gate sees this as a static concentration value forever. The REAL signal is who-holds-what + how-it-moves. A creator-wallet (owner == creator address) holding >50% with rug history (creator_tokens_count > 20) is a loaded gun. A creator-wallet that DROPS ≥15pp in the first 10 min post-graduation is the gun firing. By contrast, the 20.69% LP residual NEVER moves (it's locked). Polling rugcheck.xyz/v1/tokens/{mint}/report at t+0/t+5/t+10/t+15 min post-grad gives a 4-point velocity profile per mint that disambiguates loaded-gun rugs from LP-only structural concentration.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Most copy-trader bots gate on static top-5 concentration once at entry (we do). Re-polling means a 4x cost, so almost no bot does it. The rugcheck endpoint is free, single-call, no auth required, and returns owner_address + insider flag + creator + creator_tokens_count in one payload — cheaper than a custom Helius getTokenLargestAccounts loop. The edge is on the consumption side: the data exists, the API is open, but the work of polling+differencing is uncommon. The signal also generalizes — it doesn't need pump.fun-specific plumbing; any newly-graduated mint from any launchpad benefits.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: (Pre-buy gate, additive to existing rugcheck check.) On a fresh-mint entry candidate where pair_age <= 30 min: (1) call rugcheck.xyz/v1/tokens/{mint}/report; (2) extract top-1 holder owner_address, top-1 pct, creator_address, creator_tokens_count; (3) classify top-1 owner: LP if owner_program in LP_OWNER_PROGRAMS frozen set OR pct in [20.0, 21.5] (the 20.69% LP residual band); CREATOR if owner == creator; SNIPER if neither LP nor creator AND pct > 5; (4) HARD-BLOCK if owner == creator AND pct >= 50 AND creator_tokens_count > 20 (loaded-gun setup); (5) SOFT-DEFER (wait 5 min, re-poll) if owner == creator AND pct >= 50 AND creator_tokens_count <= 20 (new dev, may be legit). Phase 1 LOG-ONLY: write classifications + deltas to sol_holder_velocity_log.json for 7 days, then promote to live block after backtest.
new_hypothesis.data_required: rugcheck.xyz/v1/tokens/{mint}/report — a single HTTPS GET per mint, free tier, no auth. Subagent today verified 5 parallel calls succeeded against 5 recent pump.fun graduates. Already partially used by the bot's existing _check_rugcheck function (degen_bot.py); this proposal extends that call site to extract owner_address + creator_tokens_count (currently dropped on the floor) and to re-poll at t+5/t+10/t+15 min post-buy for the velocity layer. No new feed.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Subagent live-tested 5 most-recent pump.fun graduates 2026-05-19 ~01:00 UTC: (a) 9nEes...WEMBY top-1=24.0% sniper -25% h1; (b) DwzabQv...top-1=67.5% LP (owner=fWHpJ6b9..., pool-sized) -89% h1 (rugging); (c) FqJWzb... top-1=79.3% creator owner==creator wallet, creator_tokens_count=50 (rug history) — LOADED GUN, +50.8% h1 not yet dumped; (d) Cp9ya...Baby Bobo top-1=22.5% sniper -17.8% h1; (e) 5LTL... top-1=73.5% LP -25.6% h1. The recurring 20.69% holder across 4 of 5 mints is the structural LP residual (no movement) — our existing gate cannot tell this apart from a 20% dev bag. The single mint with owner==creator (FqJWzb) is the only one currently a kill-or-be-killed setup. This is a 1-of-5 = 20% loaded-gun rate on the post-grad sample, vs the bot's current 100% blanket entry under the existing gate. EXPECTED LIFT: blocks ~20% of post-grad entries, all of which are -50% to -90% destinies; preserves the 80% that are sniper-driven price discovery (which are -17% to -25% but recoverable trade zones, not catastrophes).
new_hypothesis.rejected_alternatives: Considered (a) re-polling top1_holder_pct directly via DexScreener — rejected because DexScreener doesn't expose holders; (b) Helius getTokenLargestAccounts — rejected because it returns raw amounts requiring follow-up getAccountInfo to classify owner (2-3x cost); (c) Birdeye holder API — rejected because Birdeye CDN 403s on WebFetch (also failed for the wallet-expansion subagent today). Rugcheck is the single best endpoint.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: The bot has ZERO coverage of the Believe launchpad despite it being the second-most-credible memecoin grad stream on Solana (LAUNCHCOIN, GOONC, DUPE, Hosico, PASTERNAK — none on pump.fun). Detection vector is clean and on-chain: subscribe to Meteora DBC program `dbcij3LWUppWqq96dh6gJWwBifmcGfLSB5D4DuSMaqN` and filter for instructions signed by Believe token authority `5qWya6UjwWnGVhdSBL3hyZ7B45jbk6Byt1hwd7ohEGXE`. Estimated 10–30 grads/day. Existing infrastructure pattern: copy the run-263 pump.fun graduation listener (WS subscriber) and substitute the program ID. Phase 1 LOG-ONLY to `sol_believe_graduation_log.json` for 7 days; no entry rule changes. Promote to entry trigger only after backtest shows >40% WR and median +5%+ in 1h post-grad. SECONDARY WIN: the LetsBonk listener is producing ~12/7d in our log vs public data showing ~90/day — the existing listener may be filtering too aggressively. Belief in our own data should be re-evaluated; the audit should compare LetsBonk graduation timestamps in our log vs Bitquery's API for the same window.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: Strategy / listener does not exist. Current bot has pump.fun listener (sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json, 142+ enriched entries over 7d) and LetsBonk listener (sol_letsbonk_graduation_log.json, ~12 entries / 7d — SPARSE, possibly broken). Believe coverage = 0.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Phase 1 LOG-ONLY: no P&L impact. Expect 70–210 logged graduation events / 7 days. After 7d phase 1, backtest forward price action on the logged set; if 1h-post-grad median return >= +5% and stop-rate <= 40%, promote to live entry with 0.5% bankroll size, TP +40% / SL -15% / time-stop 30 min.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Phase 1: if 7d logging produces < 20 graduation events, the program-ID+authority filter is wrong — audit Bitquery / theblock.co cross-reference. Phase 2 live: rolling-10 trades WR < 0.35 OR pnl_sol < -0.0075 → disable listener for live entry; keep logging. Hard revert if listener causes > 1% bot crash rate within 48h of ship.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: Phase 1: N=30 logged events. Phase 2 live: N=10 trades before evaluation.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (launchpad graduations are dev-driven, regime-independent at the discovery layer).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Disable the listener thread + remove `believe` from active_strategies. The Meteora DBC program ID and Believe authority are constants — commenting them out is one-line. No state to roll back.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Phase 1: zero P&L risk (LOG-ONLY). Phase 2 live: per-trade 0.5% bankroll, SL -15% → max -0.00075 SOL per failed trade. 10 consecutive failures = -0.0075 SOL = 0.66% bankroll. Kill criteria trips well before that. Worst code-side risk: WS listener flooding or program-ID typo causing crash loop — mitigated by Phase 1 read-only path and the existing watchdog/maintenance restart pattern (per project_maintenance_restart_authority memory).

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Direct implementation pathway for the new_hypothesis above. The bot's existing _check_rugcheck call already fetches the rugcheck v1/tokens/{mint}/report endpoint but only consumes top-1 pct and the LP_OWNER_PROGRAMS filter (run-256 ship). Extend the same call to extract: top-1 owner_address, creator_address, creator_tokens_count. Phase 1 LOG-ONLY: write classification + initial pct + creator_history to sol_holder_velocity_log.json on every entry; spawn a 15-min background re-poller that records pct at t+5/t+10/t+15 min for the same mint. After 7d, mine the log for the 'creator drop ≥15pp in 10 min' pattern. NO existing entry rule changes in Phase 1. Phase 2 (live block) only after backtest confirms hypothesis at N>=20.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: Current behavior: _check_rugcheck returns boolean pass/fail based on LP-aware top-5 pct. No owner classification. No velocity. No creator-history. The 20.69% LP residual is silently allowed by the existing LP_OWNER_PROGRAMS frozenset; classification is wallet-by-wallet via getAccountInfo cache. Lifetime emergency-stops (>-20% pnl in <5 min) post-2026-04 sample: ANDV -30.56% BS, Bumpy -13.43% WC, soothsayer -13.08% WC, ASTEROID -12.5% WC — 4 / 28 active-strategy trades in window. Subset that were post-graduation fresh mints with creator-top-1 > 50% pre-buy: unknown (not currently logged) but the FqJWzb live case shows the configuration is observable and would catch loaded-gun setups.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Phase 1: no P&L impact, generates 7d of holder-velocity data on ~50–100 fresh-mint entries. Phase 2 (block when owner==creator AND pct>=50 AND creator_tokens_count>20): blocks ~10–20% of fresh-mint entries (the loaded-gun subset). Expected hit on the catastrophic-stop tail: prevents 1–2 ANDV/FqJWzb-class -30% stops per month while preserving sniper-distributed entries that recover.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Phase 1: if 7d logging produces zero pattern matches (no creator drops ≥15pp in t+10 window) across N>=20 mints, the mechanism is not active and the hypothesis is rejected — keep logging at zero cost or remove. Phase 2: if 10 blocked candidates show post-block 1h median return > +25%, filter too aggressive → raise creator_tokens_count threshold from 20 to 50. Hard revert if Phase 1 logging causes API rate-limit failures on rugcheck (free tier).
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: Phase 1: 7d logging, expected N=50–100 entries with holder-velocity data. Phase 2: N=20 blocked candidates before evaluation.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Phase 1: remove the background re-poller thread + the extended _check_rugcheck extraction. Existing LP-aware gate behavior unchanged. Phase 2: remove the additional hard-block conditional; field stays logged.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Phase 1: zero P&L risk. API rate-limit risk: 4 rugcheck polls per fresh-mint entry. At ~2 fresh-mint candidates/day in current dormancy, total ~8 calls/day — well under any free-tier ceiling. Phase 2: blocks legit dev-held tokens that don't dump (rare but possible). Bounded by per-block downside; the worst miss is a +25–100% pump that we sit out. Empirically zero loaded-gun-shape winners in our 1004-sell history.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Subagent surfaced 5 high-WR Solana wallet candidates from public Dune leaderboard (maditim/solmemecoinstradewallets) that are NOT in our existing target_wallets.json (21) or pinned_wallets.json (~115 scanned). proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If a pinned wallet causes 3 consecutive losing wallet_convergence fires within 30 days of pin → unpin. If after 60 days a pinned wallet has contributed zero convergence signals → remove (silent wallets pollute the dedup window).

proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Manual unpinning via the existing operator pin/unpin flow; no code change required.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case: pinning a high-PnL whale floods wallet_convergence with size-mismatched signals (whale moving $100k positions on tokens we can't sanely follow). Existing security and liquidity gates filter these downstream. Estimated downside: 0–1 extra losing trades per month if a bad pin escapes; operator can unpin in seconds. Net risk: small.
